title: Banquet Table Continuity
description: Four reference-linked banquet heroes establishing a coherent celebratory dining campaign language.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the table scale, centerpiece hierarchy, servingware family, and celebratory light. Images 02-04 preserve that same banquet system while rotating centerpiece emphasis and course progression.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-banquet-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for the remaining series images. Queue may run the dependent variations concurrently after the reference is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
